arm_definitions.tk_split_c64: Manual C64 both directions, scratch cap 4 GiB
arm_definitions.tk_auto_c64: Auto C64 both directions enabled, forward partial cap 64 MiB

interpretation: All cases are synthetic scheduling workloads with frozen selected pairs; router excluded.
Each FWD, BWD, FWD+BWD entry is an independently measured full-operator timing, not a pure fine-kernel timing.
FWD+BWD is independently timed; it need not equal the sum of the separate medians.
Planner, task and applicable merge overheads are included; zero split rows still use task/planner paths.
Positive latency_reduction_pct_vs_tk means faster; negative means slower. Speedup is baseline_ms/new_ms.
Diagnostic H2/K4 is not a model configuration; do not mix it with H20/K64 reference cases.
These medians are one ordered experiment batch, not repeated-job averages or end-to-end model speedups.
